title: Draft help-centre FAQ
caption: The draft FAQ says every hour and 7 days. Nothing says it replaces anything, so the agent records both values.
verdict: The draft FAQ says exports run every hour and are kept for 7 days. Neither statement says it replaces the old value, so the schema tells the agent to record both values side by side rather than guess. The wiki now holds two conflicting pairs of claims.
lesson: An ingest only sees the pages it opens. Deciding between sources is left to the lint pass, which compares every claim in the wiki at once.

quotes: Your export is kept for 7 days.

lede: A draft FAQ arrives. It disagrees with what the wiki already says.
key: Your export is kept for 7 days.
did: Wrote the draft's 7 days next to the existing values, without choosing between them.
Did the same for “every hour” on the project page.
Left the disagreement for the wiki check (lint).
